scripts.test:e2e: tsc -b && vite build --mode e2e && node e2e/run.mjs
scripts.db:bundle: (echo "-- Rangers App database setup: paste into Supabase SQL Editor and Run, once, on a new project."; cat supabase/migrations/*.sql) > supabase/setup.sql && (echo "-- Rangers App update: for a project set up with an older setup.sql. Paste into Supabase SQL Editor and Run. Safe to run again."; cat supabase/migrations/0003_assignments.sql supabase/migrations/0004_fixups.sql supabase/migrations/0005_admins.sql supabase/migrations/0006_feedback.sql supabase/migrations/0007_videos.sql) > supabase/update.sql
